name: Pandemic
description: Cooperative: cure four diseases before outbreaks overrun the world. On the Brink's roles and events, Virulent Strain, Mutation and the Bio-Terrorist are switchable add-ons. Private local build: not for distribution.

epidemics.title: Epidemic cards
epidemics.description: 4 introductory, 5 standard, 6 heroic, 7 legendary (needs On the Brink).

onTheBrink.title: On the Brink: roles and events
onTheBrink.description: 6 more roles, 8 more events (2 events per player), up to 5 players.

virulentStrain.title: Virulent Strain challenge
virulentStrain.description: Virulent Strain epidemic cards replace the normal ones.

mutation.title: Mutation challenge
mutation.description: A fifth, purple disease. Not with the Bio-Terrorist.

bioterrorist.title: Bio-Terrorist challenge
bioterrorist.description: One seat is a hidden Bio-Terrorist spreading the purple disease. 3 or 4 seats suit it best (5 at most). Not with Mutation.

openHands.title: Open hands
openHands.description: Everyone sees every hand. Always on in the introductory game (4 epidemics); optional otherwise.
